Researching for a dissertation in business?

If you are a business student looking for a solid research topic, you have come to the right place. We have gathered examples of dissertation titles for Indian students (undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral). These topics respond to recent themes in leadership, marketing, HRM, finance, digital innovation and entrepreneurship. Topics could include ESG in finance, funding for startups, or the consequences of remote work. The titles included will help you take that first confident step towards a dissertation!

Management

Strategic Leadership in Uncertain Times: An Investigation of Pandemic Recovery in Small and Medium Enterprises The Role of Agile Management in Improving Organizational Efficiency in Technology Start-Ups Evaluating the Impact of Cross-Cultural Management in Asian-based Multinational Corporations Adapting to Digital Change: A Case Study on Change Management Strategies in the Era of Transformation The Role of Stakeholder Engagement on Non-Profit Project Success

Marketing

Consumer perception of sustainable branding: A Comparative Study of Gen Z and Millennials The role of influencer marketing in gaining brand loyalty: A UK perspective of the fashion industry A study of neuromarketing strategies and consumer purchasing behaviour in the retail setting Digital versus Traditional marketing in emerging economies: a case study of startups in India Exploring Customer Experience in Omni-Channel Retail: A Study of Consumer Perceptions and Engagement

Human Resource Management (HRM)

The Effects of Teleworking on Employee Performance and Wellbeing: A Cross-Nation Perspective. Diversity and Inclusion Strategies: A Study of Public and Private Sector Organizations. Strategies for Employee Engagement in High-Stress Work Environments. Talent Retention Strategies in the IT Industry: Opportunities and Challenges. HR analytics: Facilitating Strategic Workforce Planning for Modern Organizations.

Finance

The Adoption of Cryptocurrency and Its Impact on Traditional Banks Are ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) Investments Important for Portfolio Performance? Risk Management Practices in FinTechs: A Study of the Indian Leaders The Impact of Financial Literacy on Investment Decisions for Young Adults The Impact of Global Economic Uncertainty on FDI in Emerging Economies

Entrepreneurship & Innovation

Government Policies and Support for Female Entrepreneurs in South Asia Technology Innovation and Business Model Innovation: Lessons Learned from Unicorns. Crowdfunding as a Start-Up Financing Option: Success Factors and Pitfalls. The Entrepreneurial Mindset and Business Sustainability in a Post-COVID world. Green Entrepreneurship: Challenges and opportunities in renewable energy.

International Business

Globalization and Its Influence on Supply Chain Resilience within Manufacturing Firms Options for Entry for Multinational Corporations in African Emerging Markets Trade Wars and Its Influence on Global Business Strategy with Special reference to US-China Comparative Study of International v Local Brands and Consumer Choice International Joint Ventures role in Transfer of Technology If any of the titles gave you an idea, you are already a step further down the path.
